nexa-vlm-benchmark
	

nexa-vlm-benchmark is a dataset designed to evaluate the performance of vision-language models (VLMs) across multiple academic disciplines

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

The dataset consists of multiple subject-specific subsets:

ChartQA
MM-VET
POPE
MMMU
ScienceQA

question: The input prompt formatted for the model.
